Thanks for the demo last week. Our security and infra teams want a clear checklist and timeline for the POC so we can sign off on provisioning. Specifically we need the following items called out in a mutual action plan:

- Who issues API keys and what TTL/rotate policy you recommend
- Steps + contact for adding Redwood to our org (identity/SSO)

- VPC peering flow and required CIDR blocks + contacts for networking

Can you send a short, date-driven plan (owners + deadlines) so we can include it in our vendor evaluation review by Nov 15?

Also any security docs you can attach (SOC2 summary, data retention) would be helpful.

Best,

Hi Laura — thanks for the clear list. Draft MAP attached (MAP_Northridge_20261104.xlsx) with owners and dates; summary below.

Quick summary / milestones (proposed):
- Nov 5: Org invite + SSO metadata exchange — Owner: Laura (Northridge) / Action owner for Redwood: Marissa Cole
- Nov 6: API key issuance (short-lived, 30 day TTL recommended for POC) and integration notes — Owner: Jonas Weber; key will be scoped to sandbox model pool
- Nov 9: IP allowlist format agreed and initial entries submitted by Northridge; Redwood provides egress IP set — Owner: Northridge infra + Jonas for verification
- Nov 12: VPC peering request submitted (Northridge network team -> Redwood peering contact). Expect peering setup by Nov 17 (canary traffic Nov 18–19) — Owner: Karthik Iyer (Redwood infra) + Miguel (Northridge)
- Nov 17–20: Run canary workload and validate latency/throughput; rollback plan included in MAP
- Nov 24: POC close decision (pass/fail) to support procurement/contract cadence

Notes on API keys: for the POC we issue scoped keys via the Console; TTL 30d default with recommended rotation at 14d. For production we recommend short-lived service tokens integrated with your vault or our API key rotation webhook.

Security docs: attached SOC2 summary & data retention one-pager in the MAP workbook. If you want standalone PDFs I can drop them in a separate email to your security inbox.

Next steps: can you confirm the org admin who will accept the invite and the networking contact for the peering ticket? If you confirm today we can hit Nov 5 and keep the Nov 15 evaluation window.

Thanks —
Jonas

Looping Karthik in for VPC peering. A couple of operational clarifications to put in the MAP before we send the final version to Northridge:

- For peering we need the exact requested CIDR and a point-of-contact (name + email). We should also include the expected ASN if they want a managed BGP flow (we generally do static routing for POCs).
- For IP allowlist we should provide both egress IPs (for outbound to their API) and expected source IPs (if they expect us to call in). For POC simplicity we can provide a flat set of /24s and call it out as POC-only.
- Confirm we can create a single scoped API key for their sandbox project; note in the MAP that production requires per-service identity mapping.

Proposed internal owners:
- VPC peering ticket + confirmation: Karthik (infra)
- API key issuance + test key: Jonas (solutions)
- Security docs + SOC2 copy: Marissa (security liaison)

I'll add the operational templates to the MAP workbook and send the final to Laura & Miguel once I have the CIDR and their org admin.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Head of Customer Success (Evals) | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
